name: @pipeworx/mcp-sk-rpo

tools.name: rpo_search_entity
tools.description: Search the Slovak Register of Legal Entities (RPO) for companies, sole traders and public bodies. Matches are a diacritics-insensitive SUBSTRING search (e.g. "s" matches "š"), not relevance-ranked, so a short or common query can return hundreds of unrelated hits — use the fullest name you have, or the IČO, for a specific match. Legal-form suffixes (s.r.o., a.s., k.s., etc.) are part of the stored name and can be included or omitted. At least one filter is required. Returns each match's internal `id` (pass to rpo_entity_detail for the full record), current/historical names, IČO, addresses and establishment/termination dates. The upstream caps results at 500; narrow the query if you hit that.

fullName.description: Company/entity name, full or partial, e.g. "ESET" or "Slovak Telekom". Diacritics-insensitive substring match.

identifier.description: IČO — the 8-digit Slovak business identifier, e.g. "31333532". Exact match when 3+ digits.

legalForm.description: Legal form, e.g. "Akciová spoločnosť" (joint-stock), "Spoločnosť s ručením obmedzeným" (s.r.o.).

addressMunicipality.description: Municipality of the registered address, e.g. "Bratislava".

establishmentAfter.description: Only entities established on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

establishmentBefore.description: Only entities established on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

terminationAfter.description: Only entities terminated/wound up on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

terminationBefore.description: Only entities terminated/wound up on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

stakeholderCompanyName.description: Find entities where a stakeholder (owner/partner) is a company matching this name.

stakeholderPersonFamilyName.description: Find entities where a stakeholder (owner/partner) is a person with this family name.

statutoryBodyFamilyName.description: Find entities where a statutory-body member (director/executive) has this family name.

limit.description: Max results to return (default 20, max 100). The upstream itself may have already matched more — see `total_returned_by_api`.

tools.name: rpo_entity_detail
tools.description: Fetch the full RPO record for one entity: legal forms, registered address history, statutory bodies (directors/executives), stakeholders (owners/partners), equity and shares, predecessors (mergers/splits), statistical classification codes, and the source register (Obchodný register / Živnostenský register / etc.) with registration number. Pass either `id` (the internal RPO id returned by rpo_search_entity) or `ico` (the 8-digit IČO) — if you pass `ico`, this tool resolves it to the internal id first via an exact-identifier search.

id.description: Internal RPO entity id, from rpo_search_entity results (the `id` field).

ico.description: IČO — the 8-digit Slovak business identifier, e.g. "31333532". Used to look up the entity if `id` is not given.

includeHistory.description: Include historical (superseded) names, addresses, legal forms etc., not just the current ones. Default true.

includeOrganizationUnits.description: Include organizational units (branches) of the entity. Default true.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sk-rpo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sk-rpo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
